transcript.en: Good afternoon, thanks for coming to today’s lecture.
transcript.zh: 下午好，感谢大家来到今天的讲座。

transcript.en: In the last few decades, the environmental impact of food production and consumption has become one of the greatest concerns.
transcript.zh: 在过去的几十年里，食品生产和消费对环境的影响已成为人们最关心的问题之一。

transcript.en: When we look at what we eat and how we produce the food, we can find extensive evidence for how we damage our environment.
transcript.zh: 当我们观察我们吃什么以及我们如何生产食物时，我们可以找到大量证据证明我们是如何破坏环境的。

transcript.en: Greenhouse gas emissions may come from livestock such as cows, agricultural soils, and rice production.
transcript.zh: 温室气体排放可能来自牲畜例如奶牛、农耕土壤和水稻生产。

transcript.en: According to statistics, the carbon dioxide emissions from the production of the food people consume every day are almost the same as the emissions we make when we are driving.
transcript.zh: 据统计，生产人们每天消耗的食品，所产生的二氧化碳排放量与我们开车时的排放量几乎相同。

transcript.en: Let’s look at some more specific examples.
transcript.zh: 让我们看一些更具体的例子。

transcript.en: The cultivation and processing of 100 grams of coffee beans are responsible for 140 grams of carbon dioxide.
transcript.zh: 100克咖啡豆的种植和加工产生140克二氧化碳。

transcript.en: Now, some international organizations are training farmers in many countries to use sustainable agricultural methods as a way of reducing their carbon dioxide emissions.
transcript.zh: 现在，一些国际组织正在培训许多国家的农民使用可持续农业方法来减少二氧化碳排放。

transcript.en: All agricultural practices have been found to have a variety of effects on the environment.
transcript.zh: 已发现，所有农业活动对环境有多种影响。

transcript.en: Some of the environmental effects are associated with meat production.
transcript.zh: 一些环境影响与肉类生产有关。

transcript.en: The popular red meat requires 28 times more land to produce than chicken, 11 times more water and results in five times more climate-warming emissions.
transcript.zh: 广受欢迎的红肉生产所需土地是生产鸡肉的28倍，用水量是生产鸡肉的11倍，导致气候变暖的排放量是生产鸡肉的5倍。

transcript.en: According to another research, cooking process also causes greenhouse gas emissions.
transcript.zh: 根据另一项研究，烹饪过程也会导致温室气体排放。

transcript.en: Scientists now are working on how to best minimize its impact.
transcript.zh: 科学家们现在正在研究如何最大程度地减少其影响。

transcript.en: Another problem that we cannot neglect is the packaging of food products.
transcript.zh: 另一个我们不能忽视的问题是食品的包装。

transcript.en: As packaging takes a lot of energy, water and other natural resources to produce.
transcript.zh: 因为包装需要大量的能源、水和其他自然资源来生产。

transcript.en: So, a lot of natural resources are wasted when we throw the packaging materials away.
transcript.zh: 所以，当我们把包装材料扔掉时，浪费了很多自然资源。

transcript.en: Furthermore, packaging waste produces a big amount of greenhouse gas.
transcript.zh: 此外，包装垃圾会产生大量的温室气体。

transcript.en: To make things even worse, the food we eat often comes from places far away. Therefore, the transportation of our food across long distances contributes to air and water pollution.
transcript.zh: 更糟糕的是，我们吃的食物往往来自遥远的地方。因此，远距离运输这些食物导致空气和水的污染。

transcript.en: In recent decades, with the growing number of population, more food is in demand.
transcript.zh: 近几十年来，随着人口的增长，对食物的需求也越来越多。

transcript.en: So, more land has been used to produce food. Hundreds and even thousands of forests have been cut down.
transcript.zh: 因此，更多的土地被用于生产粮食。成百上千的森林被砍伐。

transcript.en: It had a devastating effect on the climate because forests can absorb greenhouse gases.
transcript.zh: 这对气候造成了毁灭性的影响，因为森林可以吸收温室气体。

transcript.en: People in different parts of the world apply various kinds of farming practices. In most countries, cows and other livestock are kept on the farms, while in some countries they are kept in a restricted area on a mountain.
transcript.zh: 世界不同地区的人们采用各种耕作方式。在大多数国家，奶牛和其他牲畜被饲养在农场，而在一些国家，它们被饲养在山区的限定区域内。

transcript.en: But they all contribute to the carbon dioxide emissions.
transcript.zh: 但它们都带来二氧化碳的排放。

transcript.en: And for animal agriculture, the problem can be more serious, because the livestock need food all the time.
transcript.zh: 而对于畜牧业来说，问题可能更严重，因为牲畜一直需要食物。

transcript.en: In America, cows eat an overwhelming amount of corn and soybeans each year.
transcript.zh: 在美国，奶牛每年吃掉大量的玉米和大豆。

transcript.en: In order to create a better world for us and our future generations, we should adopt sustainable agriculture.
transcript.zh: 为了为我们和我们的后代创造一个更美好的世界，我们应该采用可持续农业。

transcript.en: The goal of sustainable agriculture is to meet the world’s growing demand for food at the present without affecting future generations.
transcript.zh: 可持续农业的目标是在不影响子孙后代的情况下满足当今世界对粮食日益增长的需求。

transcript.en: Every person involved in the food system—growers, food processors, distributors, retailers, consumers, and waste managers—can play a role in ensuring a sustainable agricultural system.
transcript.zh: 参与食品系统的每个人——种植者、食品加工商、分销商、零售商、消费者和废物管理人员——都可以在确保可持续农业系统方面发挥作用。

transcript.en: There are many practices commonly used by people working in sustainable agriculture and sustainable food systems.
transcript.zh: 在可持续农业和可持续粮食系统中工作的人通常有许多方法。

transcript.en: Crop growers may change their food production methods to prevent pollution, although some other areas of agriculture are very hard to change, such as fishing.
transcript.zh: 作物种植者可能会改变他们的粮食生产方法以防止污染，尽管这在其他一些农业领域很难改变，例如渔业。

transcript.en: Consumers and retailers concerned with sustainability can look for foods that are environmentally friendly.
transcript.zh: 关注可持续发展的消费者和零售商可以寻找环保食品。

transcript.en: However, sustainable agriculture is more than a collection of practices.
transcript.zh: 然而，可持续农业不仅仅是各种方法的集合。

transcript.en: It is also a process of negotiation: a push and pull between the competing interests of an individual farmer or of people in a community as they work to solve complex problems about how we grow our food.
transcript.zh: 这也是一个协商谈判的过程：个体农民或社区中的人在解决有关我们如何种植粮食的复杂问题时相互竞争的利益之间的拉扯。

transcript.en: In conclusion, I want to emphasize that we may not be able to go back to the old times and live a simpler lifestyle, but we can take an active role in preventing more environmental problems caused by carbon dioxide emissions.
transcript.zh: 最后，我想强调的是，我们可能无法回到过去，过着简单的生活，但我们可以在防止更多因二氧化碳排放引起的环境问题上发挥积极作用。

transcript.en: In the next lecture, I will share some of the studies and effective solutions with you.
transcript.zh: 下节课，我会和大家分享一些研究和有效解决方案。
